inputs.lyrics:
[Intro - building energy]
[drum fill]

[Verse 1]
[rap]
[driving]
[urgent]
Static on the wire, a fire I can't put out
Every word I swallow leaves me hollow and loud
Running from the quiet, running out of ground
Screaming in my chest, I can't hear any sound
A frequency beneath it I could never name
Beating in my ribs before I had a voice
Louder in the quiet, louder in the crowd
I turn it up until I can't hear the doubt
[build-up]

[Pre-Chorus - building energy]
[sung]
[clean vocal]
[urgent]
And I feel it rising up again
The pressure underneath the skin
It's building like a wave about to break
And I am not afraid to let it in
[stop]

[Chorus - anthemic]
[clean vocal]
[melodic vocal]
[harmonies]
Cut through the static, let it scream
I am the signal in the dream
Cut through the static, break the sound
I am the noise you never found
[downlifter]

[Verse 2]
[rap]
[driving]
[urgent]
I built a wall of all the noise I couldn't say
Every brick another year I walked away
Now the quiet has a weight I never knew
Heavier than every door I never opened
So I'm tearing out the drywall with my hands
Letting all the static in again
Cause a signal that you bury isn't gone
It's just waiting for a louder song
[build-up]

[Pre-Chorus - building energy]
[sung]
[clean vocal]
[urgent]
And I feel it rising up again
The pressure underneath the skin
It's building like a wave about to break
And I am not afraid to let it in
[riser]

[Chorus - anthemic]
[clean vocal]
[melodic vocal]
[harmonies]
Cut through the static, let it scream
I am the signal in the dream
Cut through the static, break the sound
I am the noise you never found
[stop]

[Bridge - stripped back]
[clean vocal]
[breathy]
[vulnerable]
And if the signal dies tonight
I want you to remember
The quiet was the loudest thing
I ever had to carry
[riser]

[Chorus - anthemic]
[powerful belting]
[gang vocals]
[release]
Cut through the static, let it scream
I am the signal in the dream
Cut through the static, break the sound
I am the noise you never found
[crossfade]

[Outro]
[release]
